categories.name: Contrapositive
categories.description: Flip the direction and negate both sides. A → B becomes NOT B → NOT A.

questions.sentence: If it rains, the picnic is cancelled.
questions.question: What is the contrapositive?
questions.correct: If the picnic is not cancelled, it did not rain.
questions.wrong: If it does not rain, the picnic is not cancelled.
questions.explanation: Rain → Cancelled. Flip and negate: NOT cancelled → NOT rain. (B) negates the sufficient without flipping — that tells us nothing.
